name: Plug-and-Play Ray Marching and Rendering
definition: A pipeline interface that allows efficient ray marching and differentiable volumetric rendering to be plugged into any user-defined radiance field by defining two specific functions.
summary: Plug-and-Play Ray Marching and Rendering is a modular, PyTorch-based volumetric rendering pipeline that separates field queries from accumulation, enabling easy integration of custom radiance fields into differentiable, high-performance ray marching for dynamic scenes.
